body.name: Active-chart extension of the common score
body.construction: Fix the minimum-norm union coefficients \((a_x^U(P_0),d_x^U(P_0))\) from \(\mathrm{QP}_x\) at \(P_0\), retaining the same independent normal coordinates throughout its constant-rank neighborhood. For a nearby \(P\in\mathcal M_b\), set \(\phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P;\mathrm{PT},P_0)=\sum_x\{g_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)+R_{\mathrm{PT},x}(P)^{\prime}a_x^U(P_0)\}\) and \(\phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P;\mathrm{SC},P_0)=\sum_x\{g_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)+R_{\mathrm{SC},x}(P)^{\prime}d_x^U(P_0)\}\).
